source_refs.note: Topic 5.4.1.1 Model Development with the improvement tip (PDF 135-136, printed 132-133). Long question 2 is answered.

items: Define the problem: understand it and the factors that affect it, such as family size, location or income for grocery spending.
Collect data: past spending, number of family members and other relevant factors.
Choose an algorithm: a method for creating the model, such as linear or logistic regression.
Train the model: let it learn from the data to make predictions.
Evaluate the model: test it on new data to see how well it predicts.

blocks.text: To improve a model: use more data points, include relevant factors such as family size or special events, update it regularly with new data, and test predictions against actual spending (Tip).
